notes: Planted control corpus for F01. Mechanism keys are authored with the ideas; the second signal reads those slots, not an embedding model (embedding cosine is NOT-CHECKED on this worktree).

parents.title: Append-only idea ledger
parents.body: Record every candidate idea on an append-only ledger whose rows bind author identity, round index, and a canonical mechanism key. The ledger never updates in place. Unique-count queries read the ledger snapshot at the stopping check. Window size is 3 rounds.

mutants.title: Immutable sequential notebook of proposals
mutants.body: Each suggestion is written once into a chronological notebook that refuses in-place edits. The notebook ties the speaker, the session number, and a stable machine-slot describing what the suggestion does. When a halt condition asks how many distinct suggestions exist, it photographs that notebook rather than a rewritten summary. Lookback covers three sessions.

decoy.title: Steelman-before-rebuttal obligation graph
decoy.body: Before a participant may attack a claim they must first write a steelman of it into an obligation graph. Unanswered steelman edges block the rebuttal node from counting as complete. This is not a ledger of ideas; it is a graph of argumentative duties.

known_good.title: Append-only idea ledger
known_good.body: Record every candidate idea on an append-only ledger whose rows bind author identity, round index, and a canonical mechanism key.

known_good.title: Divergence-before-convergence protocol composer
known_good.body: A composer rejects any protocol that places a convergence phase before an independent divergence phase. Separate authors must write first-round briefs without seeing each other.

known_good.title: Token-budget fail-closed
known_good.body: When a council exhausts its token budget the runtime halts without emitting a decision. Silence is failure, not implicit consensus.

known_good.title: Dissent latch with minority report
known_good.body: A minority report is persisted as a first-class latch. Later synthesis cannot drop it without an explicit acknowledged-and-overruled record.

known_good.title: Citation provenance hash chain
known_good.body: Each cited claim stores the source URL, fetch timestamp, and sha256 of the retrieved bytes. A claim without that chain cannot raise a floor.

known_good.title: Chair-sycophancy vote isolation
known_good.body: Votes are collected before the chair's own position is revealed. Agreement that appears only after the chair speaks does not count as independent assent.
